queries.scope: Find a local custodian, public parcel-map entry point, and safe geometry interface.
queries.result: Official operator says it serves Valledupar’s municipal cadastre, publishes complete parcel cartography for six urban sectors and 25 rural corregimientos, and offers a citizen parcel query. Linked public geoportal exposes cadastral/property detail panels that can include NPN, address and land-area attributes; no geometry-only safe-field route was verified, so no feature query was sent. Cadastral certification products require identity/title documentation.
